a.lede: Cadence, Synopsys, and Siemens all offer agentic AI for chip design, largely built on Nvidia's stack, with varying claims of autonomy.
a.title: The state of agentic AI in chip design tools in 2026

b.lede: Synopsys unveiled seven AgentEngineer agents on its new Autopilot platform, with general availability planned for the end of 2026.
b.title: Synopsys debuts Autopilot platform for developing chips autonomously using AI
